newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa drifts lower, still rangebound.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa drifts lower, still rangebound.

text.p: Cocoa futures stayed lower by the midsession on Thursday with values easing off on lack of volume and the market was still within its immediate range.
Traders said buyers backed off after the New York market turned lower into the close on Wednesday.
Volume at 1,077 lots was far from impressive.
Benchmark September gapped seven stg lower as expected and hit a low of 1,030 stg before finishing 12 off at 1,035.
It had hit a high of 1,044 as the market bounced slightly on a few lots of buying.
Traders said the market appeared to have settled in a comfortable 1,023-1,060 stg band at the moment after the big sell-off on July 3 which saw values falling by over 100 stg in one day.
The narrow trade is likely to persist unless significant fundamental news emerge.
The U.S. second quarter grind data, due to be released on Friday, were expected to show an increase of between four and nine percent.
"But I doubt it will have a real impact on the market," said one trader.
